system.history:
A server, host, bartender, or kitchen worker who knows the venue, the regulars, and what happened just before trouble began.

Scene use: Witness, helpful guide, hostage, rumor source, or ordinary person caught in extraordinary danger.
system.personality: Observant, busy, and practiced at reading a room. Usually prioritizes the safety of coworkers and guests.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Work clothes, order pad or handheld terminal, and quick access to staff-only areas.

system.description: A desperate close-range swing with whatever is at hand.
